info.name: HealthSpeak AI API
info.description:
HealthSpeak AI: multilingual voice-first hospital intake assistant (FastAPI + PostgreSQL).

HOW TO USE
1. Start the API (python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000) and the database.
2. Collection > Variables: set `seedPassword` to SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD from the project's .env (never commit it).
3. Run the folder 'Demo flow' with the Collection Runner (top to bottom). Each request has tests.
4. 'All endpoints' lists every operation (78) generated from /openapi.json for manual trying.

Synthetic data only. The registered demo patient uses a random phone number on each run.

variable.description: SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD from .env (for staff/doctor/admin demo logins). Do not commit.

request.description: The consent text is versioned. The patient must accept it before any health data is saved.

exec: pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const j = pm.response.json();
pm.collectionVariables.set('consentVersion', j.version);
pm.test('draft wording is flagged', function () { pm.expect(j.is_draft).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 1.8 A real health concern (asks a follow-up)

exec: pm.test('status is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const j = pm.response.json();
const terms = j.assistant_message.meta.symptoms.map(function (s) { return s.term; });
pm.test('fever and headache understood', function () { pm.expect(terms).to.include('fever'); pm.expect(terms).to.include('headache'); });
pm.test('a department is suggested as preliminary', function () { pm.expect(j.assistant_message.meta.department).to.not.eql(null); });
pm.test('status is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const j = pm.response.json();
pm.test('emergency guidance, no question first', function () { pm.expect(j.assistant_message.meta.stage).to.eql('urgent'); pm.expect(j.assistant_message.content).to.include('112'); });
pm.test('status is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const j = pm.response.json();
pm.collectionVariables.set('intakeId', j.id);
pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 2. Staff: queue, evidence, priority, confirm

request.description: Set the collection variable seedPassword to SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD from the project's .env file first.

exec: pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const j = pm.response.json();
pm.collectionVariables.set('staffToken', j.access_token);
pm.test('role is staff', function () { pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('staff'); });
pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const j = pm.response.json();
const gm = j.find(function (d) { return d.code === 'general_medicine'; });
pm.test('12 departments are seeded', function () { pm.expect(j.length).to.be.at.least(12); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('departmentId', gm.id);
pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const j = pm.response.json();
const mine = j.items.find(function (i) { return i.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('intakeId'); });
pm.test('the new intake is in the queue and flagged urgent', function () { pm.expect(mine).to.not.eql(undefined); pm.expect(mine.priority).to.eql('urgent'); });

item.name: 2.4 Read the intake (original words, evidence, priority)

exec: pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const j = pm.response.json();
pm.test('saved priority is urgent, set by the system', function () { pm.expect(j.priority).to.eql('urgent'); pm.expect(j.priority_source).to.eql('system'); });
pm.test('every field says how it was found', function () { pm.expect(j.field_evidence.length).to.be.at.least(5); });
pm.test('original text kept as typed', function () { pm.expect(j.original_text).to.include('severe chest pain'); });
pm.test('no invented percentages', function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j.field_evidence)).to.not.include('%'); });

item.name: 2.5 Staff add a missed symptom (labelled as staff)

exec: pm.test('status is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const j = pm.response.json();
pm.test('not presented as AI extraction', function () { pm.expect(j.evidence.level).to.eql('staff'); pm.expect(j.evidence.label).to.eql('Added or corrected by staff'); });
pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const j = pm.response.json();

pm.test('now normal, set by staff, reason kept', function () { pm.expect(j.priority).to.eql('normal'); pm.expect(j.priority_source).to.eql('staff'); pm.expect(j.priority_reason).to.include('Postman demo'); });
pm.test('change is in the history', function () { pm.expect(j.revisions.some(function (r) { return r.field === 'priority'; })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const j = pm.response.json();
pm.test('confirmed by staff, original words untouched', function () { pm.expect(j.review_status).to.eql('confirmed'); pm.expect(j.original_text).to.include('chest pain'); });
